request.query: integer multivariate polynomial evaluated at rational coordinates denominator product lower bound absolute value

items.name: one_le_pow_mul_abs_eval_div
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|

items.name: RatFunc.denom_mul_dvd
items.type: ∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] (x y : RatFunc K), (x * y).denom ∣ x.denom * y.denom

items.name: MvPolynomial.schwartz_zippel_sup_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        p.support.sup fun s => ∑ i, ↑(s i) / ↑(S i).card

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S₁ : Type v} →
    {σ : Type u_1} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] → [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] → (R →+* S₁) → (σ → S₁) → MvPolynomial σ R → S₁

items.name: RatFunc.eval_mul
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] {L : Type u} [inst_1 : Field L] (f : K →+* L) (a : L) {x y : RatFunc K},
  Polynomial.eval₂ f a x.denom ≠ 0 →
    Polynomial.eval₂ f a y.denom ≠ 0 → RatFunc.eval f a (x * y) = RatFunc.eval f a x * RatFunc.eval f a y

items.name: MvPolynomial.schwartz_zippel_totalDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Finset R),
      ↑{f ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun x => S | (MvPolynomial.eval f) p = 0}.card / ↑S.card ^ n ≤ ↑p.totalDegree / ↑S.card

items.name: MvPolynomial.schwartz_zippel_sum_degreeOf
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        ∑ i, ↑(MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p) / ↑(S i).card
